description: This file defines the RouteCollector class within the FastRoute namespace. The class manages route collection for a web application, including adding routes for different HTTP methods, grouping routes with a common prefix, and retrieving the collected route data.

classes.name: RouteCollector
classes.description: A class for collecting and managing web route definitions, supporting various HTTP methods and route grouping.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RouteCollector with a route parser and data generator.

methods.name: addRoute
methods.description: Adds a route for specified HTTP methods and a handler, applying current group prefix.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates a route group with a prefix, executing a callback to add routes within that group.
